author: Simo-Italia
quote: I’m right there with you. GTA WOKE, all politically correct, isn’t the real GTA. They’ve just slapped the logo on it. I want GTA San Andreas back. I want GTA V with Nico **** on top of that, they’re selling it digitally, so I can’t even resell it. I thought I was buying a game where I could go rob those filthy girls after paying them. Turns out I’m the one who got robbed, bro. Not to mention that I’m forced to play the girlfriend’s personal slave the entire time, with a predetermined relationship. You took The Sims, slapped the GTA logo on it, and called it a day. Give us our money back! We want a refund!
